{{Quote|This is a ''suicide mission'' with or without you. We're outnumbered something like eight to one, and that's not counting those Star Destroyers.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Tess Alder]]|<ref name="Star Wars 4" />}}
The '''ambush of Gray Flight''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
Believing the interruption of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[mission to Dominus III]] scouting for a new base by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces to be the result of a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] within the Rebel Alliance, [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] established a [[Stealth Squadron|covert unit]] led by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], flying prototype [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] and tasked with both identifying the source of the intelligence leak and locating a new home for the Alliance.<ref name="Star Wars 1">[[Star Wars (2013) 1|''Star Wars'' (2013) 1]]</ref> To that end, Organa, as [[Gray Leader/Legends|Gray Leader]], divided the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of Gray Flight into three groups to scout potential base sites, taking [[Gray Two]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Gray Three/Legends|Gray Three]] [[Tess Alder]] to the [[Pybus system/Legends|Pybus system]].<ref name="Star Wars 4" />

At the same time, command of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] was transferred to [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Kell Bircher]].<ref name="Star Wars 2">[[Star Wars (2013) 2|''Star Wars'' (2013) 2]]</ref> Bircher&mdash;in reality a Rebel spy and nephew of Mon Mothma<ref name="Star Wars 12">[[Star Wars (2013) 12|''Star Wars'' (2013) 12]]</ref>&mdash;was given a mandate by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to hunt the Rebel Alliance,<ref name="Star Wars 2" /> and tracked Gray Flight to [[Pybus]].<ref name="Star Wars 4" />

==The ambush==
Arriving in system, Organa, Antilles, and Alder briefly observed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] below before the arrival of Bircher's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and an [[Unidentified Interdictor-class Star Destroyer (ambush of Gray Flight)|Interdictor cruiser]], which activated its [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]], preventing the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] from fleeing. To avoid the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships']] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire, Organa ordered Alder to orbit in the shadow of Pybus' [[Moon/Legends|moon]] while she and Antilles dove towards the planet's atmosphere. The Imperial forces responded with an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]], driving the Rebels to regroup and go on the offensive. Against Organa's order to go to ground, Alder joined the other two pilots in launching a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] volley against the two squadrons of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] deployed by ''Devastator'',<ref name="Star Wars 4" /> destroying eleven of the enemy craft.<ref name="Star Wars 5" /> Colonel Bircher, commanding his men from the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of a proton torpedo, hyperdrive, and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]-equipped interceptor,<ref name="Star Wars 3" /> ordered the remaining TIEs to pursue the three X-wings as they approached the Star Destroyers, preventing the capital ships from firing on the Rebels for fear of striking their own forces. As the [[TIE pilot]]s realized the ploy and broke off their attack, Organa had her subordinates lock on to her [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] transponder, which she jettisoned near the [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Interdictor]], guiding the torpedoes into its gravity well projectors and allowing the [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. However, Bircher had prepared a contingency, launching a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] in pursuit. The [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] detonated upon reversion, injuring Organa and crippling her starfighter.<ref name="Star Wars 5" />

Receiving a [[Force vision/Legends|warning]] from the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] that Organa was in danger, grounded Gray Flight pilots [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Prithi]] had [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], Skywalker's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], retrieve her coordinates, defying the Princess' orders in a rescue attempt.<ref name="Star Wars 4" />

Refusing to abandon the flight leader, despite her orders and the threat of the Imperial force's impending arrival,<ref name="Star Wars 5" /> Antilles had Organa use her still-functioning [[Maneuvering jet/Legends|maneuvering thrusters]] to move away from their reversion coordinates, distancing herself from an Imperial attack, while her astromech droid, [[R2-T4]], pressurized her [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] to slow her bleeding, and Alder reported the arrival of Skywalker and Prithi. At the Princess' direction, Luke removed a pair of [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cells]] from her X-wing, binding them to a proton torpedo and his [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometer]], set to broadcast a distress signal, and pushed the bundle off into space. Upon the Imperial group's arrival, the X-wing pilots launched another torpedo volley, passing the oncoming interceptors, and striking Skywalker's improvised explosive device. Realizing too late that his squadrons were not the intended target, Bircher jumped to hyperspace to escape the blast, and ordered ''Devastator'' to follow. The Alliance pilots did the same, slaving the now-unconscious Organa's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] to their own as they jumped to coordinates provided instinctively by Skywalker through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Star Wars 6" />

==Aftermath==
Upon her return to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], Leia Organa was given treatment by a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] and placed into a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] to recuperate, her life saved by R2-T4's efforts.<ref name="Star Wars 6" />
